claims.text: ### Diny, Gaurav & Jeevant Decode Titan's International Business **Title:** Diny, Gaurav & Jeevant Decode Titan's International Business() **Snippet:** Markose (Diny), CEO of Titan Company Ltd's International Business Division (IBD), and Gaurav Midha, Head of Watches within IBD, chat with Jeevant to decode the strategies and challenges faced by Titan in its international business ventures.

--- ### TITAN - Where Leaders Can Be Found Everywhere **Title:** TITAN - Where leaders can be found everywhere | Management Innovation eXchange() **Snippet:** Back in 2002, the leadership baton (MD) was handed over to Mr. Bhaskar Bhat from a charismatic leader, Mr. Xerxes Desai, who had established a very profitable watch business for the company and had incubated the jewellery business.
While it was a great opportunity for Mr. Bhat to take TITAN to the next horizon of growth, he faced several challenges: 1.
Profitability Erosion:** The newly incubated jewellery business was making substantial losses.
European Market Losses:** TITAN incurred huge losses when entering Europe in the mid-90s.
Despite these challenges, many ordinary employees at Titan have risen to significant leadership positions due to the company's culture of innovation and empowerment.
For example: - Manimaran started as a Diplamo trainee in the casting department and is now the Principal of the Innovation School and heads Quality Assurance for a 2 billion USD jewellery business.
- Saumen, who began as an engineer trainee in maintenance, has progressed to head Supply Chain Management (SCM), Retail, and currently manages all brands of Titan in Northern India.
These stories highlight how the culture at Titan fosters leadership development from within.

While it was a great opportunity for Mr. Bhat to take TITAN to the next horizon of growth, he faced several challenges:

1. **Profitability Erosion:** The newly incubated jewellery business was making substantial losses.
2. **European Market Losses:** TITAN incurred huge losses when entering Europe in the mid-90s.

Despite these challenges, many ordinary employees at Titan have risen to significant leadership positions due to the company's culture of innovation and empowerment. For example:

- Manimaran started as a Diplamo trainee in the casting department and is now the Principal of the Innovation School and heads Quality Assurance for a 2 billion USD jewellery business.
- Saumen, who began as an engineer trainee in maintenance, has progressed to head Supply Chain Management (SCM), Retail, and currently manages all brands of Titan in Northern India.

These stories highlight how the culture at Titan fosters leadership development from within.

Snippet: New Delhi: Titan Company has announced key leadership changes across its senior management to support succession planning and business continuity across its Jewellery and Watches divisions, according to its latest BSE filing.  
  
Arun Narayan, currently leading the company’s Tanishq India business, will take over as CEO of the Jewellery Division from January 1, 2026. He will replace Ajoy Chawla, who will assume the role of managing director of Titan Company on the same date.  
  
Kuruvilla Markose, CEO of the International Business Division, will be appointed CEO of the Watches Division effective August 13, 2025. He will succeed Suparna Mitra, who stepped down from the role in May this year.
